scope: Local JSON and local PostgreSQL. First registry example per tool whose BG and EN routes match and have required parameters. No LLM or production execution. No exceptions does not imply correct answers. Active selection includes editorial review; withheld reasons below.

withheld.regionWinners: Labels 32 electoral districts (including abroad) as oblasts; Bulgaria has 28 oblasts.
withheld.regionBreakdown: Electoral-district data described as oblast data; needs explicit geography scope.
withheld.rankPlaces: Oblast ranking includes MIR geography (31 domestic rows); needs geographic reconciliation.
withheld.airQuality: Missing readings can become zero/within limit; station fallback and averaging period need correction.
withheld.basketAffordability: GDP per capita is used as an income proxy; cannot present household affordability as measured.
withheld.budgetOverview: EU contribution is omitted from narration facts and mislabeled in the table; balance cannot reconcile from facts.
withheld.compareElections: 2024 has two elections; the example silently picks October.
withheld.institutionMaintenance: English example falls back to a national ranking instead of the requested ministry history.
withheld.socialSpending: Broad question asks total assistance spending, but answer covers procurement only.
withheld.sectionHistory: Example section has no local data.
withheld.contractSearch: English contractor name is not extracted; local result has no match.
withheld.awarderProcurement: Bulgarian example has no matched awarder.
withheld.subsidiesForEntity: Example is a placeholder with no entity/EIK.
withheld.ministryBudget: English ministry name is not resolved.
withheld.personProfile: Short-name example does not resolve in local person lookup.
withheld.personConnections: Short-name example does not resolve in local person lookup.
withheld.personWealth: Short-name example does not resolve in local person lookup.
withheld.voteSearch: English example returns no matching Bulgarian vote title.
withheld.openCalls: No open rows returned in this local snapshot; recheck current deadlines before promotion.
withheld.problemSections: Neighbourhood aggregates must not be presented as individual ethnicity or voting behaviour.
withheld.romaVoteTrend: Example generalizes tracked neighbourhoods to all Roma voters.
withheld.voteTransitions: Prompt needs to say model estimate, not observed individual voter movements.
withheld.mpAssetsTop: Richest wording overstates coverage of declared assets.
withheld.mpAssetsByParty: Richest wording overstates coverage of declared assets.
withheld.officialsAssetsTop: Richest wording overstates coverage of declared assets.
withheld.schoolScores: Best schools wording overstates a ranking by one exam metric.
